title: The People in the Dark
paragraphs: Hundreds of years went by. Kings came and went; many were unkind or foolish. The people were frightened of enemies and tired of broken promises. Into that dark, the prophet Isaiah spoke bold words: "The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light" (KJV). He saw a child coming, a child who would be a wonderful counsellor, a mighty God, an everlasting father, a prince of peace. Isaiah did not know the day, or the name, or the town. But he held up the promise like a lamp: light is coming. Many of us hear that in our favourite carols.
wonder: I wonder what light means to someone who has been in the dark for a long time?
prayer: Light of the world, shine on all who feel in the dark today, and on us. Amen.
alt: A crowd of silhouettes in darkness looks up at a great golden light shining down.
translation: Retold in our own words, with a short quotation from the King James Version.
